name: 4 Gang
description: 4 Gang (also known as 'the 4s') is a Crip-aligned criminal street gang alliance active primarily on Detroit's east side. The alliance is documented as having been formed in part by the 42 Hustle Boyz (42HB), an east-side gang historically associated with narcotics trafficking. The 4s are engaged in a prolonged rivalry with the 5s, a Blood-affiliated alliance.

sources.title: The Rise of the "5's" And The "4's" Gangs in Detroit – DetroitStreetGangs.com
